permission.runtime_guard: P08HistoryController::scope requires active actor, stable auth session, confirmed warehouse context, warehouse ACL and tenant/org match

sources.precedence: Canonical scan_events adapter rank 0 wins duplicate event IDs over scan_record_events rank 1

session.createdAt: batch.created_at only; never substituted for start/end

actor.userId: batch.created_by, or event.actor_id only when that event column is persisted
actor.displayName: null unless a historical display-name snapshot column is persisted

latestEvent.selection: All persisted events for the selected session before metricsAsOf, ordered created_at DESC then event ID DESC; not the last row of the current page
latestEvent.reason: event.reason when persisted, otherwise event.message when persisted, otherwise null
latestEvent.serial: event.serial_number only when persisted; no item_instances lookup
latestEvent.sku: event.sku_code only when persisted; no sku lookup
latestEvent.issuedQuantity: event.issued_quantity only when persisted; otherwise null
latestEvent.eventType: event.event_type only when persisted; otherwise null
latestEvent.businessLink: batch.source_type/source_id persisted reference only; URL remains null until approved target mapping

projection.quantity: issuedQuantity is null unless an authoritative persisted event field exists; scan count is not posting quantity

rules: Do not convert unavailable source to empty
Do not use current item/SKU lookup to repair history

status_mapping.REJECTED: explicitRejected only; rejected aggregate remains null
status_mapping.OTHER: other; never included in rejected total

counts.source: full persisted event sources grouped by session before page slicing
